mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET account_balance = COALESCE(account_balance, 0) + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}

UPDATE user_info SET vip_expire_time = CASE WHEN vip_expire_time IS NOT NULL AND vip_expire_time > NOW() THEN DATE_ADD(vip_expire_time, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
